title: Looting at Eridu and the campaign to save it

tellings.quote: I end up finding all these photographs over the last 10 years of locals going in and just pillaging pillaging the site

plain: The ruins of Eridu, an ancient city site in Iraq, are being stripped by looters, according to Matt LaCroix, a guest who researches ancient sites. He tells Michels that over the last ten years he kept finding photographs of locals going into the site and, in his words, "pillaging pillaging" it. He raises it because he wants the site saved before what remains of it is gone.
